title: Initial row construction
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, form a list of rows by first decoding the second component of $z$ into words. Decode each such word into entries, interpret each entry and the first component of $z$ as natural numbers, and replace each entry by its remainder upon division by the number represented by that first component.
caveat: The pair-decoding operation and the word-decoding operation are not defined in the supplied snippet.
